components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button used for Add Application and major CTA triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(37,99,235,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-kbd { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

components.name: Stage Status Badge
components.description: Color-coded badge indicating current pipeline stage.
components.css: .ds-badge-interview { background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Stage Urgency Badge
components.description: Stage-weighted duration badge indicating application staleness.
components.html: 16d
components.css: .ds-urgency-rose { background: #fff1f2; color: #be123c; border: 1px solid #fecdd3; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; display: inline-block; }

narrative.overview: Tracklet is designed as a crisp, dense, and high-clarity dashboard built for active job seekers managing high-stakes career pipelines. Every pixel prioritizes scanability, status recency, and immediate actionability over decorative clutter.
keyCharacteristics: High Information Density with zero wasted padding
Stage-Aware Urgency with context-weighted staleness signaling
Subtle Depth Hierarchy with micro-borders and soft shadows
Keyboard-First Efficiency with N and Ctrl+K shortcuts

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent colors appear on ≤10% of any given view surface.

rules.name: The Dual Register Rule
rules.body: Headings use Outfit; data attributes use JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat bounded by border-slate-200. Shadows appear only on hover or modal elevation.

dos: Do format dates in short human-readable form (Jul 15) with a full ISO date hover tooltip.
Do shade-match text colors on colored background badges (e.g. text-rose-700 over bg-rose-50).
Do keep table rows at 38px height with 1–3 clear visual signals max.
donts: Don't cram mail icons, contact badges, and task indicators into the table row company cell.
Don't use generic perpetual animate-bounce animations; use subtle animate-pulse on numeric counters.
Don't fall back silently to guest mode on cloud errors; always emit a clear user-facing toast.
